description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for filtering subordinate search parameters of an employee within an HR management system. It extends a base FilterParams class and includes a property for employee number, along with getter and setter methods, and a default sort field.

classes.name: EmployeeSubordinateSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO for specifying search filters when retrieving subordinate employees, including sorting options and an employee number filter.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the object and sets the default sort field to 'subordinate.lastName'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter value.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter value.
